text.description_html:
Rockwood 611, Traditional Style Door Knocker

This Traditional Door Knocker is made solid brass. It comes packaged with mounting hardware. It is thru-bolt mounted with 6-1/4 inch center to center mounting holes (distance between the two mounting screw holes). This front door knocker features a classic urn tip that will enhance traditional homes; but it is still timeless enough to look great in almost any setting while still adding a beautiful a functional finishing touch to your front door. It can even be engraved for a personal touch.

Specifications for the Traditional Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Height: 6-3/4"
  • Width: 3-5/8"
  • Mounting Centers: 6-1/4" c.c. (distance between the 2 mounting screws)
  • Fastner: 2 ea. 8-32 x 2 FH MS (for standard 1-3/4" doors); 2 ea. #8 Finish Washers
  • Includes matching finish mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
